The University of Akron will not engage in unethical recruitment
practices of this protected student population. Unacceptable practices
include offering inducements to any individual for the purpose of
securing enrollments of Service members, providing commission, bonus
or other incentive payment based directly or indirectly on securing
Service member enrollments, or engaging in high-pressure recruitment
tactics.
